name: Shibatte Mitai no!
source:
Main character is into SM stuff, but his girlfriend is totally alienated by it. The goal is to work at part-time jobs and buy books and accessories with the money earned. With the right approach girlfriend will also evaluate his efforts.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角很喜欢SM，但他的女朋友对此完全疏远。目标是做兼职，用赚来的钱购买书籍和配件。通过正确的方法，女朋友也会评价他的努力。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
